introduction: Fork-authoritative sync lets a carry-patch workspace declare its fork (origin) rather than the hub as the authority for patch branches, so that POST /workspaces/:slug/sync brings every registered patch branch to the fork's tip, triggers a rebuild when one does, and records per-patch fork-sync state.

glossary.PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE: Workspace variable selecting the authority for patch branches: 'hub' (default) or 'origin'.
glossary.PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY: Workspace variable selecting how a diverged patch branch is handled in origin mode: 'replace' (default) or 'report'.
glossary.backup ref: refs/hub/replaced/<branch>, written with the pre-replacement local tip before a diverged branch is replaced.
glossary.carry-patch workspace: A workspace in workspace_mode 'carry_patch', with a trunk clone holding an 'origin' remote (the fork) and an 'upstream' remote.
glossary.fork-refresh step: The per-patch loop, run in origin mode after the origin fetch, that brings refs/heads/<branch> to the fork's tip for every active, conflict or disabled patch.
glossary.patch advanced: A patch branch that was created, fast-forwarded or replaced during the fork-refresh step.

requirements.title: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE and PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY workspace variables
requirements.rationale: The authority for patch branches and the divergence handling must be an explicit, per-workspace, re-read choice, not a hard-coded or cached one, so existing workspaces are unaffected by default.

criteria.condition: a sync starts for a carry_patch workspace
criteria.action: read PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE via GetVariableFunc("workspace", slug, "PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE") and treat any value other than the exact string "origin" (including unset) as "hub"
criteria.contract: the resolved mode ('hub' or 'origin') is computed fresh from the current variable value on every sync call, never cached across syncs

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE resolves to 'origin' for the sync
criteria.action: read PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY via GetVariableFunc("workspace", slug, "PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY") and treat any value other than the exact string "report" (including unset) as "replace"

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE resolves to 'hub' for the sync
criteria.action: skip reading PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY and run the origin fetch and fork-refresh step of requirements 2 and 3 as no-ops

for any workspace, produce the same sync behaviour and response shape as before this spec when PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is unset or 'hub', regardless of whether that workspace previously ran a sync in 'origin' mode

requirements.title: Fetching the origin remote during sync
requirements.rationale: Bringing patch branches to the fork's tip requires an up-to-date view of the fork, fetched under the same lock and credentials as every other trunk git operation.

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE resolves to 'origin' for the sync
criteria.guard: the upstream fetch of the sync has already completed successfully
criteria.action: fetch the 'origin' remote of the trunk clone with refspec +refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/* and git.NoTags, using the auth resolved by workspace.ResolveCloneAuth (GIT_PAT, then GIT_USERNAME/GIT_PASSWORD, then no auth), while still holding the sync's wslock

criteria.condition: the origin fetch fails
criteria.action: abort the sync without writing upstream_head_sha, last_sync_at, any patch status, or any patch ref from this sync attempt
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with message "origin fetch failed"; the workspace row and every patches row are byte-for-byte unchanged from before the sync started

criteria.condition: errors.Is reports the origin fetch error as git.NoErrAlreadyUpToDate
criteria.action: treat the fetch as successful and proceed to the fork-refresh step
set the sync response field origin_fetched to true only on a sync where the origin fetch of criterion 02-REQ-2.1 was attempted and succeeded, and to false in every other case including hub mode

requirements.title: Bringing each registered patch branch to the fork's tip
requirements.rationale: The fork-refresh step is the mechanism that makes origin mode true: every eligible patch branch is brought to the fork's tip deterministically, with divergence handled by policy and without racing a concurrent push.

criteria.condition: the origin fetch of requirement 2 succeeds in a sync where PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is 'origin'
criteria.action: consider, in position order, every patch of the workspace whose status is 'active', 'conflict' or 'disabled', excluding any patch with status 'merged_upstream' or 'deleted' and excluding the integration branch even if a patch row names it

criteria.condition: a considered patch's refs/remotes/origin/<branch> does not exist after the fetch
criteria.action: leave refs/heads/<branch> untouched and record sync state missing_on_origin for that patch without changing its status

criteria.condition: a considered patch's refs/heads/<branch> does not exist locally but refs/remotes/origin/<branch> does
criteria.action: create refs/heads/<branch> at the origin tip using update-ref and record action created

criteria.condition: a considered patch's local and origin tips resolve to the same commit
criteria.action: record sync state in_sync for that patch and write no ref

criteria.condition: a considered patch's local tip and origin tip differ and GitRunner.IsAncestor reports the resolved local tip SHA is an ancestor of the resolved origin tip SHA
criteria.action: move refs/heads/<branch> to the origin tip using update-ref and record action fast_forwarded

criteria.condition: a considered patch's local tip and origin tip differ and neither resolved SHA is an ancestor of the other, or the origin tip is an ancestor of the local tip
criteria.guard: PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY resolves to 'replace' for this sync
criteria.action: write the current local tip to refs/hub/replaced/<branch> (overwriting any prior value), then move refs/heads/<branch> to the origin tip using update-ref, and record action replaced with both the replaced local SHA and the new origin SHA

criteria.condition: a considered patch's local tip and origin tip differ and neither resolved SHA is an ancestor of the other, or the origin tip is an ancestor of the local tip
criteria.guard: PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY resolves to 'report' for this sync
criteria.action: leave refs/heads/<branch> untouched and record sync state diverged with both the local SHA and the origin SHA

criteria.condition: the fork-refresh step moves refs/heads/<branch> for a branch that is the trunk clone's currently checked-out branch
criteria.action: run git reset --hard to the branch's new tip immediately after the ref move, so the trunk's working tree matches its HEAD

requirements.title: Rebuild trigger, early return, and last_sync_at
requirements.rationale: A patch-only change under origin mode must be able to trigger a rebuild exactly as an upstream advance does, and the dashboard must be able to show when a workspace was last checked even when nothing changed.

criteria.action: treat every patch branch created, fast-forwarded or replaced under requirement 3 as "patch advanced" for the purpose of the early-return and auto-rebuild decisions

criteria.condition: a sync completes its upstream fetch and, in origin mode, its fork-refresh step
criteria.guard: upstream did not advance and no patch advanced
criteria.action: return early with an empty patches_merged array and rebuild_triggered false, without enqueuing a rebuild

criteria.condition: a sync completes without error, whether or not it returned early under 02-REQ-4.2
criteria.action: update the workspace's last_sync_at to the current time

criteria.condition: a sync does not return early under 02-REQ-4.2
criteria.guard: the AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC workspace variable is not the exact string "false"
criteria.action: enqueue an auto-rebuild using the existing group key slug + ":" + integrationBranch and duplicate suppression, exactly as when only upstream had advanced
run the existing merge-upstream detection loop over the branch tips as they stand after the fork-refresh step, so a branch fast-forwarded or replaced in this sync is checked against its refreshed tip

requirements.title: Sync response additions
requirements.rationale: Callers scripting against sync need a reliable signal that the fork was consulted, a per-branch account of what happened, and a quick list of anything left diverged.

criteria.action: include origin_fetched as a boolean field in every sync response, present regardless of PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE resolves to 'origin' for the sync
criteria.action: include patches_synced as an array with one element per patch considered under requirement 3, each shaped {branch_name, action, state, local_sha, origin_sha, replaced_sha}, where action is one of none, created, fast_forwarded, replaced and state is one of in_sync, diverged, missing_on_origin, and replaced_sha is present only when action is replaced

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE resolves to 'hub' for the sync
criteria.action: omit patches_synced from the response

criteria.condition: PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY resolves to 'report' for the sync
criteria.action: include patches_diverged as an array of the branch names recorded with state diverged during this sync, empty when none

criteria.condition: PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY resolves to 'replace' for the sync
criteria.action: return patches_diverged as an empty array, since divergence under replace is resolved rather than reported
criteria.contract: patches_diverged is present and empty; no branch name is added to it under replace

requirements.title: Persisted per-patch fork-sync state
requirements.rationale: The three new nullable columns give operators and API clients a durable, per-patch view of the last fork-sync outcome, and must be cleared when a workspace switches back to hub mode so stale fork state never lingers.

criteria.action: add nullable columns origin_sync_state, origin_sha and origin_synced_at to the patches table through an idempotent ALTER TABLE, skipping any column that already exists

criteria.condition: the fork-refresh step of requirement 3 considers a patch in a sync
criteria.action: write that patch's origin_sync_state (one of in_sync, diverged, missing_on_origin, or null when the branch was just created and is now in sync), origin_sha, and origin_synced_at

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE resolves to 'hub' at the start of a sync
criteria.action: set origin_sync_state, origin_sha and origin_synced_at to null for every non-deleted patch of the workspace during that sync

criteria.condition: a client requests GET /workspaces/:slug/patches, GET /workspaces/:slug/patches/:id, or PATCH /workspaces/:slug/patches/:id
criteria.action: expose origin_sync_state, origin_sha and origin_synced_at on the patch record, using the existing null convention for unset nullable fields (matching upstream_pr_url)

criteria.condition: a client requests GET /workspaces/:slug/patch-status
criteria.action: include origin_sync_state, origin_sha and origin_synced_at on each patch entry and add patches_diverged and patches_missing_on_origin counts to the summary, computed the same way as the existing status counts

requirements.title: Audit events for fork-authoritative sync
requirements.rationale: A replace outcome discards commits from the hub's copy and needs its own audit trail distinct from the batch-level record of what a sync did.

criteria.condition: a sync in origin mode completes its fork-refresh step
criteria.action: emit one hub.patch.sync audit event with actor type system, resource type patch, and metadata {origin_fetched, created, fast_forwarded, replaced, diverged, missing_on_origin} listing the branch names in each category

criteria.condition: the fork-refresh step records a replaced outcome for a branch
criteria.action: emit a hub.patch.replace audit event carrying the branch name, the replaced local SHA and the new origin SHA, in addition to the hub.patch.sync event

criteria.condition: the configured audit.Emitter is nil, or Emit returns an error
criteria.action: skip emission silently when the emitter is nil, or log the error and continue when Emit fails
criteria.contract: the sync's HTTP response and state changes are unaffected by a nil emitter or an audit emission failure

execution_paths.title: Origin-mode sync creates a fork-only patch branch and triggers a rebuild

steps.action: sets PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE=origin on a carry-patch workspace and pushes a new patch branch to the fork only
fetches upstream, then fetches origin, and finds the patch branch missing locally but present on origin
creates refs/heads/<branch> at the origin tip, records action created and origin_sync_state in the patches table, and emits a hub.patch.sync audit event
treats the created branch as patch advanced, enqueues an auto-rebuild, and returns origin_fetched=true, patches_synced, rebuild_triggered=true
calls GET /workspaces/:slug/patch-status and observes the patch's origin_sync_state and the updated summary counts

execution_paths.title: Diverged patch branch is replaced under the default divergence policy

steps.action: force-pushes a rewritten history for a registered patch branch to the fork while the hub still holds the old tip
calls POST /workspaces/:slug/sync on a workspace with PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE=origin and PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY left at its default
fetches origin, resolves both tips, and determines via GitRunner.IsAncestor that the two have diverged

backs up the old local tip to refs/hub/replaced/<branch>, moves refs/heads/<branch> to the origin tip, resets the working tree if that branch was checked out, and emits hub.patch.replace and hub.patch.sync audit events
records action replaced and persists origin_sync_state/origin_sha/origin_synced_at on the patch row, then returns patches_synced with the replaced entry and rebuild_triggered=true

execution_paths.title: Hub-mode workspace is unaffected and clears stale fork state after a mode switch

steps.action: leaves PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE unset on a carry-patch workspace that previously ran with PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE=origin and has patches carrying origin_sync_state
re-reads PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE as hub, skips the origin fetch and fork-refresh step, and clears origin_sync_state, origin_sha and origin_synced_at to null for every non-deleted patch
runs upstream fetch and merge detection exactly as before this spec, sets origin_fetched=false and omits patches_synced, and updates last_sync_at even when upstream has not advanced
calls GET /workspaces/:slug/patches and observes the three fork-sync fields are null on every patch
